note: The files this extension shares with the browser extension, copied from postulo-chromium at this commit, each with its SHA-256. `npm test` fails when a copy no longer matches; `npm run shared:sync` copies them again from a checkout beside this one and writes the new commit and hashes. src/lib/languages.js is this extension's own: it lists every language the core has, where the browser extension lists the started ones (scripts/languages.py).
